pairs.difference: Both whistles use a mild three-quarter view: the upper face, circular side and mouth opening agree spatially. B exposes more of the mouth opening, but neither shows clearly excessive perspective.
B's bell dominates the upper right while the mouthpiece shrinks at the far left, producing stronger near-to-far enlargement. A's bell, tube and mouthpiece read at a more even scale.
pairs.fix: Show the horn with gentle perspective, keeping the bell and distant mouthpiece closer in apparent scale.

pairs.difference: A shows slightly more of the tea surface; B uses a slightly lower view. In both, the cup rim, handle and saucer share a consistent, mild perspective.
Both baskets show the apple tops and upper rim from a modest elevated view. The handle, basket opening and ground agree in each; the different basket shapes do not establish a camera problem.
B exposes a broad opening and substantial inner barrel wall, with more deck visible behind it. A's opening is a narrow ellipse and its deck reads from a lower camera.
pairs.fix: Lower the camera so the barrel opening becomes a narrow ellipse, with only a little inner wall visible.

pairs.difference: B's front bumper and nearest wheel loom relative to the rear wheel and cabin. A keeps the front and rear of the taxi closer in apparent scale, giving a gentler spatial reading.
pairs.fix: Use mild perspective, reducing the enlargement of the front bumper and nearest wheel relative to the rear of the taxi.

pairs.difference: B looks down into the tent onto a broad bedding surface, with the foreground lantern, tent and distant forest forming distinct depth steps. A shows the entrance more upright and keeps the clearing comparatively shallow.
pairs.fix: Lower the viewpoint and show less of the bedding's top. Keep the tent and surrounding clearing in a shallow, compact space.

pairs.difference: B shows a broad soup ellipse and looks down across the stone ring, separating foreground stones, pot and forest into a deeper stage. A shows a narrower soup surface and a more upright support frame with less ground exposed.
pairs.fix: Lower the camera so the soup surface is a narrower ellipse and less of the fire ring's top is visible. Keep the pot, supports and forest in a compact depth range.

pattern: Generated cards tend to reveal more top surfaces, enlarge nearer parts and separate foreground props from the background into a deeper stage.
